<quote by="Announced by Laughlan, Master of the Rings">I announce the construction of the Parador of the Kindled Flame. This will be built in Siroc, Madruga. It will cost 27 wains of white granite with 2 crowns per wain labour costs. It is a folly, an orphanage for the children of the Brass Coast to be cared for and taught our traditions by the hakima and kohan.</quote>
* Constructs a folly in [[Madruga]]
* Announcement by the [[Master of Rings]]

* Summer 385YE

* 54 crowns in labour costs
